plan: LA-80 c1. Score each survivor on non-HT tablets (Tablet + Lames, all sites but HT, KH5 excluded): partial Spearman with covariates log signs, log lines, edge share and site dummies. Primary: share of survivors whose test sign equals the HT sign, against (a) the same share for survivors of the 20 shuffled-HT runs, (b) 2,000 random valid pairs (sign of their HT r). Kill: primary share <= 0.60 or not above the 95th pct of shuffled-run survivors.
